Definition: from G1518; to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize:--make peace.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to make peace, to bring warring sides together, and Paul uses it once, for what Christ did on the cross. Having made peace through the blood of His cross, God reconciles all things to Himself, whether things on earth or things in heaven. One act of peacemaking covers the whole creation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cross is where peace was made, because God did not wait for us to come to Him; He came to us and paid for the peace Himself.
